head: feature/custom-fields-integration
title: feat: integrate custom fields UI components
body:
## Summary

Integrates the customizable logbook UI components into the existing pages so users can create projects with templates, edit entries with typed field editors, view formatted field values, and upload file/image attachments.

## Changes

### Dashboard.tsx — New Project Modal
- Added template picker button with modal (built-in / personal / global tabs)
- Template selection auto-populates project columns from template fields
- Expanded field type dropdown with all 15 canonical types
- Built-in templates: Lab Notebook, Field Log, Project Tracker, Inspection Report

### NewEntry.tsx — Entry Form
- Replaced string-based field definitions with `FieldDefinition` objects
- Legacy `custom:type` format auto-converted to proper select fields
- Typed values (`Record<string, unknown>`) instead of string-only
- `FieldEditor` components render appropriate input for each of the 15 field types
- `FieldDisplay` components for read-only entry view
- File/image editors wired to attachment upload API (lease-based flow)
- `project_id` and `entryId` passed through for attachment context

### New Components
| Component | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `FieldEditors.tsx` | Typed editors for all 15 field types |
| `FieldDisplay.tsx` | Read-only display with SafeMarkdown |
| `TemplatePicker.tsx` | Template selection with scope tabs |
| `templateApi.ts` | Template CRUD API client |
| `attachmentApi.ts` | Attachment lease/upload/finalize client |

### Backend (from PR #218)
- Template CRUD endpoints with 4 built-in presets
- Attachment lease-based upload flow
- Entity linking field support
- Migrations 015–018

## Testing
1. Run migrations 015–018 in Supabase SQL Editor
2. Open app → click **+** → **New Project** → click **📋 Choose a Template**
3. Select a template → columns auto-populate
4. Create project → add entry → verify typed field editors render correctly
5. Test file/image upload fields with attachment flow
